name: camp_and_watch
proto: int camp_and_watch(int hours, int watch_member, uint flags)
purpose: Camping on the camp combat map, run by ROOT run_encounter (vector 1778:08f6; flags bit 1 = dungeon, bit 7 = dungeon room). Clears g_protection_turns/g_status_icon/g_active_member, init_combat_party (or DNGLOOK b40e(0, dungeon cell)), g_active_combatant = 0xff, end hour = (hour+hours) mod 24, watch forced to -1 outside -1..5. Every G/P/S member except the watch is put to sleep (sleep_combatant_unless_poisoned; poisoned members counted); a Bard on watch with sound plays a tune (sprite 0x5f, g_tune_pos = 1, animate_wait(0x34)). Prints 0x41d4 then loops until the end hour: refresh, regeneration_ring_tick, status window; when the hour just changed a 1/64 roll causes an ambush, else pass_time(5), wait_ticks(1), sky strip (g_location temporarily = g_location_backup if < 0x21) and a 1/4 chance the watch wanders one random cell (combat_pos_in_bounds + COMBAT a290). Ambush: set_random_seed(get_time_hash()), monster = g_camp_monsters[rand 0..7] (0x1734), 'Ambushed!', with a watch roster 0..5 are woken ('G' or 'P'), setup_encounter(monster, flags) (or DNGLOOK b40e(1, cell)), return 1. No ambush: g_hours_until_heal != 0 or hours < 6 -> 'No effect...'; else 'Party rested!': unpoisoned living non-watch members gain rand 1..63 HP (cap max) and mana (+0xf) = INT (A/M) or INT/2 (B); outside dungeon fights 25% apparition (g_save_unk_2e7 = g_month, OUTSUBS a8e8); g_hours_until_heal = 14. Finally 'S' -> 'G', active member restored, status window, return 0.

0x1734.name: g_camp_monsters
0x1734.meaning: monster types that can ambush a camp

notes: Ghidra's local_1a juggling is just the roster-entry pointer of the watch.

name: sleep_in_bed
purpose: Hole up in a bed in a settlement (dispatch 'H' on tile 0xab, vector 1778:08ae). 'For how many hours?' reads a digit (space cancels, '0' nothing), echoes it, end = hour + n mod 24. 16 NPC ticks (NPC b044(hour)) with refreshes (abort if g_save_unk_1018[0] == 'a'); 'G' members -> 'S'; status, 0x421e, map window blanked (set_color(0), fill_rect(0xb7,0xb7,8,8)). Until the end hour: pass_time(10), TOWN 8340 day/night switch at hours 20 and 5, draw_sky_strip, end_of_turn_party_update, status, TOWN 9864 (NPC placement), any object on the party cell interrupts ('Thrown out of bed!'), wait_ticks(1). Then 'S' -> 'G', g_party_x += 1 and slot 0 x += 1, g_view_dirty = 1, active member restored, redraw.

name: require_on_foot
purpose: 1 when g_transport_tile is 0x1c/0x1d (on foot); otherwise prints 'On foot' (0x423e) and returns 0.

name: can_board_ship
purpose: 1 when the transport tile is a carpet (0x14..0x15), on foot (0x1c..0x1d) or a skiff (0x28..0x2b); otherwise 'On foot' (0x4248) and 0.

name: land_nearby
purpose: 1 when any of the view cells (5,4) (5,6) (6,5) (4,5) around the centre is land per is_land_view_cell.

name: is_land_view_cell
purpose: View tile at g_view_tiles[x + y*0x20]: 0 -> the object layer g_view_objects[x + y*0x10] decides (carpet 0x1b, groups 0x1c/0x24/0x10/0x28 count as land); else can_enter_tile(tile, 0x1c).

name: cmd_board
purpose: Board (dispatch 'B', vector 1778:08ba). Outside dungeons the object on the party cell (find_object_at, slot in g_dx): horse (& 0xfe == 0x10; in a settlement refused (0x425e) when its NPC has a mode) 'horse' transport = tile+2; carpet 0x1b 'carpet' 0x14; skiff group 0x28 (0x4275) transport = tile; frigate group 0x24 (can_board_ship) 0x427c, 'DANGER! SHIP BADLY DAMAGED!' if hull (value1) < 10, skiffs = value3 (+1 if arriving by skiff; an arriving carpet is refolded), slot 0 value1 = hull, 'WARNING! NO SKIFFS ON BOARD!' if 0, slot 0 value3 = skiffs, status dirty, transport = tile. Other objects: 0x42bf, return 0. The slot is cleared, g_view_dirty |= 2. Dungeon: 'Not here!'. Returns 1.

name: fire_ship_cannon
purpose: Frigate broadside outdoors. Transport must be 0x20..0x27 (else 0x42c6); direction asked; must be perpendicular to the ship's facing (tile bit 0) else 'Fire broadsides only!'. play_tone_sweep(300,5,200,1000); up to 3 cells: the first object that MAINOUT 922c calls moving and is not 0xec-group is the target: COMSUBS f4be(1, ty-py+5, tx-px+5, 5, 5) (0 aborts), refresh, flash_tile_at, value1 -= rand 1..20; below 0 (>= 0x80) the slot is cleared, g_view_dirty |= 2. No target: f4be(1, 3dy+5, 3dx+5, 5, 5).

name: cmd_fire
purpose: Fire (dispatch 'F', vector 1778:08c6). Dungeon 0x42e4; overworld fire_ship_cannon. Settlement: timed door restored; a cannon (tile group 0xb4) in the view N (0xab87) / E (0xaba8) / S (0xabc7) / W (0xaba6) of the party, else 0x42eb; its facing (tile & 3) is the shot direction; 0x42f2, tone, TOWN 8b28 (alarm). Up to 4 cells: empty cell with a door tile (0x97..0x99, 0xb8..0xbb) -> door hit; object with tile > 0x1b not 0x78-group/0x2f-group, or horse 0x10/0x11 -> object hit (slot g_dx). COMSUBS f4be(1, vy, vx, vy0, vx0) animates; hits flash. Door: 'Door destroyed!', tile 0x44, g_view_dirty = 1, g_door_tile = 0. Object slot != 0: cleared, g_view_dirty |= 2, karma -5 (min 0), NPC killed + removed (TOWN 82ee/8222/8280). Slot 0: damage_whole_party.

0xab87.name: g_view_tile_north
0xab87.meaning: view tile north of the party (row 4, col 5)

notes: Ghidra shows print_string(0x42f2, ...) with junk extra arguments.

name: cmd_ignite_torch
purpose: Ignite torch (dispatch 'I', vector 1778:08d2). 'None owned!' without torches; else g_torches--, outside dungeons g_torch_turns = 0xf0, in a dungeon add_u8_capped(&g_torch_turns, 0x70 + rand 0..15, 0xff).

name: cmd_new_order
purpose: New Order (dispatch 'N', vector 1778:08de). 0x4318; select_party_member_no_zero twice ('with' between; -1 -> 0x4320/0x4340); member 0 -> 0x4329/0x4349 + leader name + 'must lead!'; else 0x4359 and the two 32-byte records at 0x55a8 are swapped via a local buffer, g_status_dirty = 1.

name: cmd_xit
purpose: Xit (dispatch 'X', vector 1778:08ea). (The guard 'loc < 0x20 && loc > 0x29' is impossible.) By transport group: 0x10 horse: 0x43a4, leaves the horse (tile-2), on foot; 0x14 carpet: with land nearby or a walkable tile under the party 'carpet!' leaves 0x1b, else 'No land nearby!'/'Not here!'; 0x1c 0x4368; 0x20 'Under sail!'; 0x24 frigate: 0x43d2, land nearby -> on foot, else no skiffs -> carpet (g_magic_carpets--, transport 0x14) or 'No skiffs on board!', else skiff (transport+4) with skiffs-1 left aboard; 0x28 skiff: land required, not on 0x6a/0x6b ('Not here!'), 0x43ca. Leaving spawns the vehicle: set_monster_slot(find_spawn_slot(), slot0 value1, z, y, x, tile, tile), value3 = skiffs, draw_status_window.
notes: local_a (skiffs stored in the new object) is uninitialised for horse/carpet/skiff in the original; Rust uses 0.

name: yell_shadowlord_name
purpose: Summon a Shadowlord by name in locations 0x1e..0x20. The text must contain one of the names at 0x444a[0..2], party y > 1 and g_shadowlord_loc[i] != 0xff, else 'No effect!'; a Shadowlord (tile 0xfc) already in the table -> 'No effect!'. Else g_save_unk_325 = i, slot spawned 2 cells north (tile 0xfc), the highest free NPC index gets state (active, slot, x, y-2, z), schedule words 0x5d6a/0x5d6c = 0, 3 schedule entries AI 6 at (x,y-2,z), type 0xfc; 'A shadowlord appears', play_sweep_noise(2,2000,0x7530,1,0x28a0), fade-in (tile 0x16, tile_transition_effect(3,5,0x1fc), tile 0xfc); return 0.

0x5f5e.name: g_npc_states
0x5f5e.meaning: NPC state records (+0 active, +2 x, +4 y, +6 z, +0xc slot)

notes: Returns print_string's AX in the failure paths (Rust: 1).

name: meditate_at_shrine
proto: void meditate_at_shrine(int y, int x, int virtue)
purpose: 'Upon what virtue dost thou meditate?' (15 chars) must contain virtue name 0x1f4e[virtue]; then 3x 'Mantra:' must each contain mantra 0x1f5e[virtue]. All right and (x,y) == (g_shrine_x[virtue], g_shrine_y[virtue]): g_shrine_destroyed[virtue] &= 0x7f, 'The Shrine is restored!', earthquake_shake, map tile = 0x19, g_view_dirty |= 2; else newline.

name: yell_word_of_power
purpose: For dungeon i = 0..7 whose word (g_word_of_power_ptrs) is in the text: 'A word of power is uttered', earthquake_shake; adjacent view tiles W/S/E/N checked for g_dungeon_open_tiles[i], 0xdf (sealed entrance) or 0x1a (shrine); shrine -> meditate_at_shrine(y, x, i); else if the cell is the dungeon entrance (g_location_x/y[0x20+i]) g_dungeon_open[i] ^= 0x80 and map tile ^= open_tile ^ 0xdf, g_view_dirty |= 2. No word -> 'No effect!'.

name: cmd_yell
purpose: Yell (dispatch 'Y', vector 1778:05ea). On a frigate outside combat toggles sails: group 0x20 -> 0x451a transport += 4, else 0x4521 transport -= 4. Else 0x4529, read_text_line(30): empty 'Nothing'; else newline and overworld yell_word_of_power, dungeon 'No effect!', settlement yell_shadowlord_name. Returns 1 / the sub-result (originally print_string's AX in some paths).
notes: The AX-return paths are translated as 1 (a turn); the main loops only distinguish 0/2/3.

name: is_pushable_tile
purpose: 1 for tiles 0x5b, 0x90..0x93, 0xa5, 0xa6, 0xa8, 0xa9, 0xad..0xaf, 0xb4..0xb7 (pushable furniture/cannons), else 0.

name: orient_pushed_tile
proto: uint orient_pushed_tile(int pull, uint base, int dy, int dx)
purpose: base+1 for dx 1, +2 for dy 1, +3 for dx -1 (facing after a push); pull flips (^2).

name: push_tile
proto: void push_tile(int dy, int dx, int ty, int tx, int y, int x, byte far_tile, byte tile)
purpose: 'Pushed!': map[ty][tx] = tile, map[y][x] = far_tile; groups 0x90/0xb4 re-oriented with orient_pushed_tile(0,...).

name: pull_tile
proto: void pull_tile(int dy, int dx, int y, int x, int py, int px, byte tile, byte under)
purpose: 'Pulled!': map[py][px] = tile, map[y][x] = under; groups 0x90/0xb4 re-oriented with orient_pushed_tile(1,...).

name: cmd_push
purpose: Push (dispatch 'P', vector 1778:058a, also COMBAT a8ce). Timed door restored, direction asked; in combat the active combatant's roster x/y replace g_party_x/y and COMBAT b3aa(y,x) != 0 aborts. Target must be object-free and pushable; needed floor 'E' for 0xb4 cannons else 'D'. Beyond free with that floor -> push_tile; else party standing on that floor -> pull_tile; else "Won't budge". The party moves into the vacated cell (g_view_dirty = 1); in combat the roster entry and the monster slot indexed by roster +3 move, g_party_x/y restored, refresh.
notes: The combat branch indexes g_monster_x with roster +3 (member) rather than +4 (slot) - kept literal, TODO(verify).

name: combat_escape_all
purpose: 'Escape' for the party (vector 1778:060e). Any live party member (flags & 0xa0 == 0x80): ' Not here!' in a 0x80 fight, ' Not yet!' while enemies remain -> return 1 (refused). Else '!' and every roster entry (COMBAT b4c6(-1-i)) and monster slot (b4c6(i+1)) is removed with refreshes, tone sweep, return 0. g_status_dirty = 1.

name: select_reagents
purpose: Mix reagent picker: lists owned reagents in the status window (window 1 redefined rows 9..0x26/0x27, 'Reagents:' title at 0x8f64, 'NN name' lines from g_reagent_name_ptrs), first line highlighted. Keys: 2/4 down, 1/3 up, Enter/space toggles bit 0x80>>index and draws/erases the 0x0f marker at column 3, Esc -> 0xffff (newline), 'M' -> done (0x8f6e). Returns the mask.

name: ask_mix_count
purpose: 'How much?' read_number(2); re-asks with 'Insufficient reagents!' while a selected reagent has fewer; 0 accepted. Returns the count.

name: cmd_mix_reagents
purpose: Mix (dispatch 'M', vector 1778:0902). 'No reagents owned!' if all 0. 'For what spell...' CAST2 e2be picks the spell (-1 -> 0x8fbe). Arrow help line, select_reagents, ask_mix_count; Esc or count < 1 -> redraw only. Non-empty mask: 'Mixing...' (animate_wait(10) outside dungeons else wait_ticks(10)), count subtracted from each selected reagent; mask == g_spell_reagents[spell] (0x1cc0) -> 0x8ffc and g_mixed_spells[spell] += count (cap 99), else explosion: newline, trap_effect(g_dx after find_first_conscious_member). Empty mask 'Nothing to mix!'. Status window rebuilt.

name: cmd_klimb_outdoors
purpose: Klimb outdoors (dispatch 'K' with g_location == 0, vector 1778:091a). No grapple 'With what?'; transport != 0x1c 'On foot!'. Direction; tile 0x0d 'Impassable!'; 0x0c: each living member rolls rand 1..30 vs DEX, failure prints 0x904a and damage_party_member(rand 1..5, member); then MAINOUT 8524(dy, dx) moves the party. Else 'Not climbable!'.
